modelDescription: When it comes to nostalgic firearms and their historical significance, Cimarron Firearms makes some of the truest and best available. The Cimarron Firearms 1873 Short Rifle is a classic example of one of the all time favorite rifles from the old west. Arguably the most famous lever action ever produced, the 1873 was favored by the likes of Pat Garrett, William Buffalo Bill Cody, Butch Cassidy and William H Bonney aka Billy The Kid. This cowboy lever action is truly The Gun that Won the West! Its compact slab sided design is perfect for riding in a saddle scabbard, making it a favorite of the Texas Rangers. This 1873 Short Rifle features a 20 barrel with a walnut stock making it a practical shooter for the farm or ranch. It's a fantastic Cowboy Lever Action at an affordable price and will impress both new and seasoned shooters alike. Cimarron Firearms has a solid reputation for designing and manufacturing some of the very best reproductions available. The 1873 is ready for Cowboy Action Shooting competitions, hunting heavy cover or just some good ol' target shooting fun. Regardless of why you need one or maybe you just want one, the Cimarron Firearms 1873 Short Rifle is an excellent addition to your collection. Get your lever action fix with Cimarron.
